system_prompt_style.note: Paper refers to prompt design in App. G, which is not in the evidence; the repo evidence is Spider 2.0, not Spider2-V.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: we leverage the task instruction as the query vector, bge-large-en-v1.5 [33] as the embedding model, and LlamaIndex [18] framework as the retrieval to generate document context for each task example.
env_context_strategy.note: The RAG context covers app documentation, not the environment itself. Screenshots and the a11ytree are observations. Could arguably be coded mixed.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: the history trajectory window size to 3, the maximum length of a11ytree to 5000 tokens
context_compaction.note: Only the last 3 turns are kept, and the a11ytree observation is truncated.

observation_format.evidence_quote: a multimodal agent can observe real-time image-style screenshots and text-style accessibility tree
observation_format.note: The main experiments use Set-of-Mark for VLMs and the a11ytree only for text-only LLMs (Sec. 4.1).

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: pyautogui code slightly outperforms self-customized JSON dict
tool_call_format.note: The pyautogui code action space is the stronger setting. The JSON dict action space is an ablation alternative.

tool_count.note: The action space is pyautogui code, not a tool schema.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: This action can be clicking on a certain pixel of the screen ( CLICK(560, 200)), or writing code through keyboard (TYPE("ls -lh") ).
edit_primitive.note: The agent has no edit tool. Files are edited via GUI typing or code.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The interaction loop repeats until an action that marks termination (DONE or FAIL) is generated or the agent reaches the max number of steps.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: With such stepwise oracle tutorials, data agents do not need to reason and plan
planning_granularity.note: The paper describes no plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: The baseline method includes 3 schemes in zero-shot prompt learning

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The baseline method includes 3 schemes in zero-shot prompt learning

short_term_state.evidence_quote: the history trajectory window size to 3

long_term_memory.note: The document warehouse is retrieval over documentation, not memory.

self_verification.note: Execution feedback appends grounding errors, which is not verification. Benchmark evaluators run after termination.

rollback.evidence_quote: we invoke a series of function calls based on a pre-stored virtual machine (VM) snapshot to reset the environment
rollback.note: This is a benchmark-level reset before each task, not an agent-invocable rollback.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The interaction loop repeats until an action that marks termination (DONE or FAIL) is generated or the agent reaches the max number of steps.
termination_condition.note: The step cap is 15 turns, with a one-hour limit (Sec. 4.1).

timeouts.evidence_quote: we require the agent to complete the tasks within both 15 interaction turns and one hour

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: built upon virtual machines (VMs) and adapted from OSW ORLD [34]

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: a multimodal agent can observe real-time image-style screenshots
filesystem_access.note: Full desktop control inside the VM is inferred.

network_policy.evidence_quote: This environment is connected to the real-world Internet

tracing.note: The paper mentions error analysis on trajectories but no trace format.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Spider2-V contains 170 initial state configurations and 151 evaluation scripts
eval_hooks.note: The evaluation is part of the benchmark itself.

target_domain.evidence_quote: the first multimodal agent benchmark focusing on professional data science and engineering workflows
target_domain.note: The other domain is data science and engineering.

open_source.note: The provided repo is Spider 2.0; LICENSE content was not shown. Code is at spider2-v.github.io per the paper.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: We experiment with state-of-the-art LLMs and VLMs including closed-source ones GPT-4 series [21], Gemini-Pro-1.5 [26], Claude-3-Opus [2], QWen-Max [3] and open-source representatives

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Our code and data are available at https://spider2-v.github.io.
primary_artifact.note: The listed repo xlang-ai/Spider2 contains Spider 2.0 agents, not the Spider2-V agent.

first_release_date.note: Based on the paper v1 date as a fallback.

pinned_version.note: The repo evidence is main cafb867 (2026-08-12) of Spider2, which is a different system; no tag is given.
